decisions.reason: Close to the firm's established portfolio, the option remains inexpensive to keep open while market acceptance is still uncertain, and missing website archives do not justify dropping it.
Building on existing capabilities, the option has low keeping costs and unresolved market value, so the firm would maintain it despite the absence of web archives.
Close to existing products, the low-cost option to continue learning about its market value supports keeping it open rather than dropping based on incomplete website data.
